lines.en: I tap on Miku's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
: Miku reporting in! To what do I owe the pleasure, Sensei?
: Hey. I was just wondering if you were up to anything tonight.
: Is that your wiener wondering? Or your heart?
: Say no more cause Miku Maruyama ain't got nothin' else to do and'll take up the job!
: Oh, but if Makoto asks, I never saw ya. Don't even know where you live.
: You two have literally come here together on multiple occasions.
: Weird. Musta caught whatever your memory disease is when you splooged all over my face.
: Please don't say that ever again.
: Aye aye, sir! Now, buckle your seatbelt and scotch-guard the corners cause I'll be there quicker than ya can say David Beckham!
: Thanks for the invite, Sensei. Was startin' to wonder when I'd get to be alone with ya again.
How should I spend my time with Miku?
